chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, raising it, said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Allah, Mighty and Majestic, defends the house from crumbling by the pigeons.'
ai.seo_question: Why do pigeons help prevent a house from crumbling according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the metaphysical wisdom behind keeping pigeons, asserting that their presence acts as a divine safeguard against the structural decay or collapse of a home. This narration reflects the Shia tradition of viewing natural phenomena as signs of God's continuous care (*tawqif*), linking domestic tranquility to specific created beings as part of the cosmic order.
